title: Your first Card

files.text:
from inputs.number.hello.Number import Number
import outputs.result.hello.Result as result_out


def main(ctx):
    n = ctx.input("number", Number).Value()
    factor = ctx.params().Factor()
    b = ctx.builder()
    result_out.Start(b)
    result_out.AddValue(b, n * factor)
    ctx.output("result", b, result_out.End(b))
    ctx.display_text(f"{n} × {factor} = {n * factor}")

run.host: Darwin arm64, tsugumid on the host

steps.say: The run begins at the start Card.
Sends the number 21, which you can edit on the Canvas.
Multiplies the number it receives by factor, outputs the result and shows it on the Card.

intro: The smallest Workflow, made in the chapter on writing Cards by hand.
finale: The result appeared in multiply's display. Inputs and outputs are in the record, and you can change factor and rerun only multiply.
